d: Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.

Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

Responsible for supervising the operation, maintenance, and repair of all HVAC systems and equipment throughout the hotel or resort, ensuring guest comfort, operational efficiency, safety, and compliance with hotel standards.
Supervise the daily activities of HVAC technicians and ensure timely completion of maintenance tasks.
Implement preventive and corrective maintenance programs for chillers, AHUs, FCUs, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems.
Troubleshoot equipment faults and ensure prompt resolution of HVAC-related complaints and breakdowns.
Maintain comfortable temperatures and proper ventilation in guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house facilities.
Monitor equipment performance and energy consumption to improve efficiency and control costs.
Ensure compliance with safety procedures, environmental requirements, and hotel operating standards.
Maintain accurate maintenance records, work orders, and equipment inspection reports.
Coordinate with other hotel departments, contractors, and suppliers to support smooth operations.
q: Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Refrigeration, or a related technical field.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant HVAC experience, preferably in a hotel or resort.
Strong technical troubleshooting, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, preventive maintenance, safety procedures, and energy conservation.
Technical Expertise | Team Leadership | Guest Service Orientation | Safety Awareness | Problem-Solving | Energy Efficiency
The above duties are not exhaustive, and additional responsibilities may be assigned according to operational requirements.
